lines.en: The next thing that enrages me
lines.ja: 続きまして…許せないもの…

lines.en: is people who are too lazy to return the grocery cart!
lines.ja: ショッピングカートを元の場所へ戻さない奴ら！

lines.en: You had the energy to go into the store,
lines.ja: 店に入って買い物して…

lines.en: collect your groceries,
lines.ja: 外まで運んで…

lines.en: and push it out, trolley, cart, whatever the heck you wanna call it!
lines.ja: そこまでは頑張れるっていうのに…

notes.meaning: 「一体何と呼ぼうと」。heck は hell を和らげた口語表現

lines.en: You had the energy, the strength, to do all that.
lines.ja: そこまでちゃんとする元気があるのに

lines.en: And you cannot return an empty cart?
lines.ja: なぜお前はカートを戻せないのか？

lines.en: Not only that, not only that!
lines.ja: それだけじゃない！

lines.en: Not, you know, not just leaving it to the side,
lines.ja: 端っこやその辺に放置するとか

lines.en: leaving it in a random spot,
lines.ja: それならともかく

lines.en: You know, not just that!
lines.ja: あろうことか…

lines.en: Leaving it in a parking spot.
lines.ja: カートを駐車場に放置する奴もいる

lines.en: What is wrong with you?
lines.ja: お前どうした？

lines.en: At-At least push it to the side if you are going to be that lazy!
lines.ja: 面倒くさくても、せめて端には寄せろ

lines.en: At least, leave it out of the way!
lines.ja: せめて！邪魔にならない場所に！

lines.en: But leaving it not at a parking spot—
lines.ja: なんと駐車場どころか…

lines.en: In the middle of the road!
lines.ja: 道路の真ん中に放置する奴まで！

lines.en: Who the heck—
lines.ja: ふざけ…っ！

lines.en: OK, maybe those are just ones that were not returned,
lines.ja: そりゃね、ただ戻し忘れたカートが

lines.en: and, you know, ended up rolling or something?
lines.ja: 転がってきたって可能性もあるよ？

lines.en: But when I— when I see them in parking spots
lines.ja: でも駐車場にカートを放置したら

lines.en: they're usually at the end,
lines.ja: 最終的に…

lines.en: Like, where, you know, where would you call that?
lines.ja: あれ…あの…なんて言うんだ？

lines.en: I could see how they could easily end up going into the road, in the middle of the road.
lines.ja: すぐに道路まで転がってきちゃうわけよ

lines.en: I just don't get it.
lines.ja: 意味分かんない

lines.en: Why is it so hard to return it, after all you did with that cart, or trolley?
lines.ja: 買い物の後にカートを戻すのがそんなに難しい？

lines.en: After, the 10 minutes?
lines.ja: 買い物は10分？

lines.en: 20 minutes?
30 minutes?
40 minutes?
Hour?
lines.ja: 1時間？

lines.en: ...You spent with that trolley/cart, getting to know it,
lines.ja: その時間をそのカートと過ごしカートと出会い

lines.en: and trusting it with your food.
lines.ja: カートに食べ物を託し

lines.en: The journey you went on, with that—
lines.ja: カートと旅をしたなら…

lines.en: You did not have the decency
lines.ja: 最後は家まで送ってやるのが

lines.en: to return it to its home,
lines.ja: 良識ってものじゃない？

lines.en: so it could be safe?
lines.ja: 危ないとは思わない？

lines.en: And so that others could be safe, and not hit carts?
lines.ja: 周りの人にぶつかったらとか思わない？

lines.en: Shame. Shame...
lines.ja: 恥を知れ

lines.en: Absolute shame!
lines.ja: 恥を知れ！
